messages:
Linh T: Heads up 0k bonus posted but my federal withholding jumped way up and my net pay is almost zero this period. Bonus was supposed to be after-tax.
Grace (People Ops): Oh no. Can you DM details (screenshot + bonus date)? We sometimes see bonus paycode defaulting to 'supplemental - default withholding' which can be taxed differently.
Linh T: Sent DM. Bonus ID #B-444. Paycode says 'SUPP-STD'. I selected after-tax in the bonus portal.
Raj - Payroll: Thanks. Looks like the bonus portal didn't propagate the 'after-tax' flag to payroll due to a webhook error on 03/02. Our system applied default supplemental federal withholding (22% flat) plus state withholding. If you opted after-tax, we can reverse and reissue the net. We'll file an exception and do an off-cycle net reissue.
Linh T: That would be great. Any impact to year-to-date withholding or 941 reporting?
Raj - Payroll: Off-cycle adjust will reconcile YTD. For employer payroll taxes (941) the taxable wages remain the same because the gross was correct; it's only the employee withholding timing that changes. No employer tax change expected.
PayrollBot: Ticket PR-2199 created: "Bonus after-tax flag not propagated - B-444". Priority: High.
Grace (People Ops): We'll confirm when off-cycle posts. Sorry for the hassle. :slightly_smiling_face:
